reason: The README describes a dsh subagent provider whose primary purpose is orchestrating delegated tasks through Qoder Cloud Agents, including automatic agent and environment discovery or creation, prompt routing, streamed execution, research, and repository analysis.

summaries.zh: 将任务委派给 Qoder Cloud Agents，并根据提示自动路由到研究或仓库分析代理后返回执行结果。
summaries.en: Delegates tasks to Qoder Cloud Agents, automatically routing prompts to research or repository-analysis agents and returning their execution results.

capabilities: Delegates prompts to Qoder Cloud Agents
Authenticates to Qoder Cloud using a personal access token from an environment variable
Finds or creates cloud agents and execution environments
Streams session events and returns agent results
Enables delegated web research, repository analysis, file access, and code editing through configured cloud-agent tools
